title: Call scATAC peaks and infer motif, chromVAR, and peak-to-gene evidence
description: Direct Codex to validate 10x fragments and paired RNA/ATAC count evidence, call peaks with MACS3 FRAG semantics, scan declared motifs against supplied peak sequences, construct reproducible GC/accessibility-matched chromVAR backgrounds, calculate motif deviations, execute Signac peak-to-gene linking, and retain reload-validated method-specific evidence without causal overinterpretation.
intents: 单细胞 ATAC peak calling motif chromVAR peak-to-gene 调控分析
questions: Which accessible regions, motif deviations, and RNA-linked peaks are supported by validated single-cell ATAC and paired RNA evidence?
preconditions: Fragments have valid five-column 10x FRAG semantics and declared genome build; paired ATAC and RNA matrices contain identical unique cells in identical order; peak coordinates, sequences, genes, motifs, and source count locations are explicit; output paths are new.
assumptions: MACS3 peaks depend on fragment aggregation and declared genome size; chromVAR deviations depend on motif definitions and matched backgrounds; peak-to-gene correlation is association evidence and does not establish direct regulation.

quality_gates.description: Every fragment record, count, and selected barcode must be structurally valid and reconciled before peak calling.
MACS3 narrowPeak and summit outputs must be nonempty, coordinate-valid, reloaded, and bound to source and parameter digests.
RNA and ATAC cells, source counts, feature identifiers, and metadata order must be exact and unchanged.
Peak sequences and motif identities must be explicit; chromVAR backgrounds must be reproducible and matched on GC and accessibility rather than sampled without control.
Motif matches, chromVAR deviations, and peak-to-gene associations must remain method-specific evidence and cannot be collapsed into causal claims.
Reload and reconcile peak, motif, background, deviation, link, version, parameter, and digest outputs before admission.

version_differences.description: FRAG parsing, duplicate handling, call-summits behavior, and narrowPeak outputs are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Use explicit FRAG mode and independently reload interval outputs and fragment accounting.

version_differences.description: Peak covariate matching, correlation, z scores, p values, distance filtering, and link storage are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Record every matching and threshold parameter and retain reloadable link fields.

version_differences.description: Background matching and deviation/z-score assays are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Freeze seed, GC bias, accessibility, iterations, window, bins, and reload deviation assays.

version_differences.description: PFMatrix/PWMatrix conversion and sparse motifMatches output are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Require named motifs and exact peak sequences and retain the sparse peak-by-motif matrix.

limitations: Validated execution covers barcode-filtered MACS3 FRAG peak calling, supplied-sequence motif matching, chromVAR backgrounds/deviations, and paired-cell Signac LinkPeaks. It does not establish direct transcription-factor binding or causal peak-gene regulation, replace donor-level differential accessibility, infer missing RNA, or manage scientific environments and compute infrastructure.

concept_sources: Project-owned ATAC regulatory workflow retaining method-specific peak, motif, deviation, and link evidence.

template_sections.purpose: Establish fragment, barcode, coordinate, genome, sequence, motif, count, and cell contracts.
required_logic: Inspect the actual fragments and paired matrices and require exact identifiers, coordinate systems, genome build, source digests, motif resource, sequence provenance, biological samples, and new output paths.
Freeze barcode selection, MACS3, chromVAR background, and LinkPeaks parameters before inspecting evaluation labels or expected loci.

template_sections.purpose: Call peaks from barcode-accounted fragment evidence.
required_logic: Validate every five-column FRAG record and optional barcode allow-list, then execute MACS3 with explicit genome size, q value, duplicate, and summit policy.
Reload narrowPeak and summit coordinates and reconcile source, selected, and excluded fragments and barcodes.

template_sections.purpose: Calculate sequence-bound motif and chromVAR evidence.
required_logic: Match named motif matrices against exact supplied peak sequences and preserve the sparse peak-by-motif matrix.
Use a fixed seed and explicit GC/accessibility-matched chromVAR backgrounds and retain backgrounds, raw deviations, and z scores separately.
Use exact paired RNA/ATAC cells, supplied gene coordinates, normalized RNA, explicit distance/minimum-cell/background/score/p-value parameters, and sequence-derived peak covariates.
Retain scores, z scores, p values, peak and gene coordinates and report associations rather than causal regulation.

template_sections.purpose: Verify source preservation and every method-specific artifact.
required_logic: Reload peak, motif, background, deviation, link, RDS and JSON outputs and reconcile all dimensions, identifiers, counts, parameters, versions and digests.
Preserve method disagreement and require donor-aware downstream inference for condition-level claims.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Call peaks on declared cells and biological aggregation units; preserve barcode accounting and avoid mixing contrasts before donor-aware review.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require nonempty coordinate-valid peaks and source/selected/excluded fragment reconciliation.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use fixed-seed GC/accessibility-matched backgrounds with explicit iterations, window, and bins.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require complete in-range background indices and finite motif deviations and z scores.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Select explicit minimum-cell, distance, correlation, background-sample, and p-value thresholds from observed support rather than desired genes.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Retain all tested link fields and separate association from causal interpretation.

preflight_checks: Inspect actual 10x fragments, optional barcode allow-list, count matrices, metadata, peak and gene coordinates, peak sequences, motif objects, genome build, source digests, versions, and output paths.
Confirm exact paired cell order, count semantics, coordinate conversions, sufficient trans-chromosomal background peaks for LinkPeaks, and compatible existing MACS3 and R package profiles.
postflight_checks: Reconcile fragment records/counts/barcodes and reload narrowPeak, summits, motif matches, chromVAR backgrounds/deviations, peak-gene links, RDS, tables, reports, versions, and digests.
Evaluate planted or independent truth only after parameter freeze; require biological replication before condition-level accessibility, motif, or link claims.
forbidden_actions: Do not install, update, activate, create, or manage Python, R, Conda, container, CPU, GPU, Slurm, remote, or local-model infrastructure.

Do not silently intersect or reorder cells, guess genome builds or coordinate systems, synthesize missing sequences, overwrite source counts/fragments, tune parameters toward expected loci, or report unexecuted outputs.
Do not call motif presence, chromVAR deviation, or peak-gene correlation direct transcription-factor binding or causal regulation.
